name: Feedback Sentiment Routing
description: Save positive Typeform feedback in Notion and notify Slack, or create a Trello card for neutral and negative feedback.
requirements: Google Cloud Natural Language enabled project and API key for Open Flow or OAuth2 credential for n8n
Notion data source with Name title and Feedback rich-text properties; n8n requires a database containing exactly one data source
Slack channel and Trello list with connected accounts

source.path: Notion/Add positive feedback messages to a table in Notion.json
